title: Fixed Twin-Treadle Irrigation Pump
description: One newly authored whole fixed twin-treadle irrigation-pump-inspired prop: two long grounded skids and crossmembers support a shared lower collection-housing exterior, two upright shoulder barrels with annular occupied rod glands, separate vertical piston-style rods and visible transverse pins under two long broad timber treadles. The treadles share a full rear axle on two real frame posts and are fixed at unequal raised angles. One forward hollow discharge connector and a shorter rear hollow connector have real small exposed annular mouths; their roots terminate in the solid lower housing, not a continuous fluid circuit. New complete low pedal/rod/barrel/shared-housing arrangement and coordinates; no old pump, spinning-wheel or foot-tray mesh imported or doubled. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres/Z up and true whole horizontal bounds-centred. Static game-art only, no working piston/valves/pedal linkage, liquid, pressure/lift/flow/efficiency, irrigation performance, human fit/standing load, use advice, manufacture or safety claim.
